title: Only a customer invitation carries the estimated-opens image; its load is counted, a test send never is, and the image door is public and cookie-free
steps: Run the send ledger, unsubscribe wiring and mounted UI suites from this branch against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL), with the fake Google that records every raw message and a fake aMember.
expect: A test send has opens null and its HTML has no /o/ image; /sending opens is null before any customer invitation.
A customer invitation's HTML has one 1x1 image /o/<43-character token>.gif after UNSUBSCRIBE; its row has opens {firstAt:null,count:0}; /sending opens is {tracked:1,opened:0}.

Three loads of the image answer 200 image/gif GIF89a, no-store, no Set-Cookie; the row then has count 3 and a firstAt; /sending opens is {tracked:1,opened:1}; the database holds the token's hash, not the token.
Unknown or malformed /o/ paths answer the same image and count nothing.
Through the full app, /o/<token>.gif is mounted and sets no cookie.
Review content shows Estimated opens 1 of 2 and an invitation row with Opened (estimated).
fence: Fake Google and fake aMember only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address. Private PostgreSQL and a temporary key vault.

tests: estimated opens: only a customer invitation carries the image; a load is counted once as opened, never on a test
the invitation open image is mounted, public and sets no cookie
Send to customer asks once more, then posts no address; the server picks the customer
